svg.title: Kummer-Chart Hodge-Tate Windows, Behrend-Sparse Frobenius Orbits, and Four Local Defect Regimes in Stage 07 (CupOrthogonalityBounds.lean + CrystallineDefect.lean)
svg.desc: Two-panel editorial mathematical diagram of Stage 07 local p-adic Hodge lifting and crystalline dual defect bounds across CupOrthogonalityBounds.lean (25 declarations) and CrystallineDefect.lean (18 declarations, 43 total, 0 stub truncations). Left panel (Hodge-Tate Windows and Behrend-Sparse Frobenius Orbit, cobalt and amber): Part 1 shows the opposite Hodge-Tate jump windows FitsWindows (fitsWindows_and_image_neg_sub_one) for a Galois lattice L with jump set U and its Tate dual with jump set U' = {-u - 1}: both share the central low band [-eta, eta] with eta = h_2^2 + 1 and h_2 = D.halfGap = D.r^8, while far jumps sit in opposite far windows -/+ epsilon_i [S_i, S_i + 4t], where S_i = farWindowStart D i sigma = w_i(sigma) - 2t uses w_i(sigma) = D.natB at b-places and D.offWeight elsewhere. Part 2 depicts a Kummer-chart Frobenius orbit of Teichmuller letters cycling under letterFrob : i |-> i^p with gap scale J = floor(log_l(h_2^3)), illustrating Behrend-sparse b-letters via notMem_bPlaces_of_coefficientEmbedding_eq_pow (consuming Stage 01's progression-free D.bPlaces and D.sparse): after two b-letters separated by gap d_1 in [1, J], a third b-letter within gap d_2 in [1, J] is excluded, and the next b-letter is only allowed after a long gap > J; chart data are packaged by eventually_exists_lettersReadThick and KummerChart.universalSide. Right panel (Four Prime Regimes -> Uniform defectBound -> Global Sum, emerald): stacks the four prime regimes of CupOrthogonalityBounds.lean converging into CrystallineDefect.lean::normLength_dualDefect_le_of_isSummandClass. Regime 1 (Generic large l, emerald): under NoMultipleNear and no small negative jump in [-a, 0) (or U' subset [-eta, 0]), dualDefect = 0 (dualDefect_eq_zero_and_dualDefect_le part (a)). Regime 2 (Few low jumps, cobalt): at most m jumps in [-eta, eta] gives dualDefect <= 11 f (m(a + 1) + rk(L)(W + 1)) len(O/l) (part (b)). Regime 3 (Two-size / Behrend-sparse b-letters, l <= 2b, amber): any pattern yields cup exponent <= 10^4(K + floor(log_l(2(b + M)))) (hasCupExponent_any_pattern), while Behrend-sparse b-letters drop this to the rank-independent exponent 10^3(delta + (J + 1)M) (hasCupExponent_sparse_thick). Regime 4 (Tame inertial chart at p_0, p_1, rust): IsTameType with e = lcm_{1<=i<=r}(p^i - 1) <= p^(r^2) gives cup exponent <= 3r^2(N + 1)^2 + 150(eta + W + 1) independent of e (hasCupExponent_of_isTameType). All four regimes converge into the uniform bound normLength(dualDefect) <= [G_l : Gamma] * rk(L_c) * defectBound(D, l) / s (s = 1 for the main summand, s = D.t for each character summand), where defectBound D l = 10^6 (m/k)(b v_l(M) + lambda_l) and lambda_l = crystallineLoss(h_2, b, l) = v_l((2b)! * (prod_{k in (b - 30 h_2^3, b + 30 h_2^3]} k)^(h_2^3)). Finally, summing localDefectBound D l = 4f * defectBound D l weighted by log l across primes in FitTwistsExist.lean yields at most 4 * 10^6 e^180 f (m/k) b log b, well below D.denominatorBudget = f a log^3 b / (m k).

g.text: Kummer-Chart Windows, Behrend-Sparse Orbits & Defect Regimes
At each embedding σ of E, U (lattice L) and U′ (dual L∨(1)) sit opposite:
Tate dual u ↦ −u − 1 sends U & U′ into opposite far windows ∓εi[Si, Si + 4t]
Teichmüller letters i ∈ k.Letter cycle clockwise under Frobenius:
No 3 b-letters occur with both Frobenius gaps in [1, J]:
Kisin Frobenius safe-move walks → explicit cup exponent e (pe Zf ⊆ ⊥)
Directly consumes Stage 01 progression-free D.bPlaces into Regime 3,
cutting small-prime cup exponents to rank-independent 10³(δ + (J+1)M).
● PART 2 · FOUR PRIME REGIMES → DEFECT BOUND
NoMultipleNear · no small neg. jump in [−a, 0) (or U′ ⊆ [−η, 0])
≤ m jumps in [−η, η] per embedding
④ TAME INERTIAL CHART AT p0, p1
e = lcm1≤i≤r(pi − 1) ≤ pr² · monic ℤp-poly deg ≤ N
normLength(dualDefect) ≤ [Gℓ : Γ] · rk(Lc) · defectBound(D, ℓ) / s
s = 1 (main summand, c = none) · s = D.t (characters, c = some c′)
defectBound D ℓ = 10⁶ (m / k) (b · vℓ(M) + λℓ)
λℓ = crystallineLoss(h2, b, ℓ) = vℓ((2b)! · (∏k∈(b−30h₂³, b+30h₂³] k)h₂³)
For ℓ > 2b, ℓ ∤ M: (2b)! contributes 0; only primes dividing (b−30h₂³, b+30h₂³] pay λℓ > 0
sum across ℓ with log ℓ
∑ℓ (4f · defectBound D ℓ) log ℓ ≤ 4 · 10⁶ e¹⁸⁰ f (m/k) b log b
≪ D.denominatorBudget = f a log³ b / (m k)
LEGEND: ◆ Cobalt = Windows & Regime 2 · ▲ Amber = Low band / sparse b / global sum · ●■ Emerald = Dual U′ / zero defect / uniform bound · × Rust = Forbidden b / tame p₀,p₁ / Stage 01
